answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 147767 Country: Australia Title: Can you make multiple duas after each 2 rakah prayer of salah al-Hajah or can you only make once after each prayer? Question: Can you make multiple duas after each 2 rakah prayer of salah al-Hajah or can you only make once after each prayer? Answer ID: 147767 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 411/373/B=5/1438) One can make multiple duas after Salah al-Hajah and after each fardh salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
